title: My Big Family
paragraphs: Ini pagi hari Jumat, dan kakek Hassan sedang perlahan bersiap-siap ke masjid. Ia sudah cukup tua sekarang, dan setelah karier panjang serta seumur hidup membesarkan keluarga besar, hal-hal sederhana membutuhkan waktu lebih lama dari sebelumnya.
Hassan duduk dan membantunya mencari sandal di dekat pintu. Ia juga membawakan sajadah kakeknya dan tas kecilnya. "Terima kasih, cucuku, kau sangat baik kepadaku," kata sang kakek dengan hangat.

Mereka berjalan ke masjid bersama, perlahan dan tenang, sambil membicarakan kenangan lama di sepanjang jalan. Hassan merasa bangga bisa mendukung seseorang yang telah puluhan tahun mendukung seluruh keluarga tanpa pernah meminta imbalan apa pun.

Setelah shalat, mereka duduk di luar sejenak, memperhatikan orang-orang yang lewat. Hassan menyadari bahwa rutinitas tenang di hari Jumat ini, yang berulang selama bertahun-tahun, adalah hal yang menyatukan keluarga besar lintas generasi.
answerKey: It is Friday morning, and Hassan's grandfather is slowly getting ready for the mosque. He is quite old now, and after a long career and a lifetime of raising a large family, simple things take him more time than before. Hassan sits down and helps him find his shoes near the door. He also carries his grandfather's prayer mat and his small bag. "Thank you, my boy, you are very kind to me," the grandfather says warmly. They walk to the mosque together, slowly and calmly, talking about old memories along the way. Hassan feels proud that he can support someone who spent decades supporting the rest of the family without ever asking for anything back. After the prayer, they sit outside for a while, watching people pass by. Hassan realizes that this quiet Friday routine, repeated for years, is exactly what holds a big family together across different generations.
